name: Galeria (shopping centre, St Petersburg)
note: Shopping centre on Ligovsky Prospekt 30A, St Petersburg (galeria.spb.ru); official partner of HC Shanghai Dragons per the club's 2026-27 partner page. The club's logo file for this partner is named 'logotip_gorizont'; the relationship between the Galeria centre and a «Горизонт» brand was not verified. Ownership of the mall not traced from open sources.
